summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K reporting a September 8, 2026 purchase agreement for $625M of 6.250% senior notes due 2032 and $625M of 6.625% senior notes due 2035, sold at par to initial purchasers led by J.P. Morgan, with net proceeds of roughly $1,236M. Proceeds, plus cash, fund the previously announced Hennessy Automobile dealership and real-estate acquisition. Closing expected September 22, 2026. Unsecured senior guarantees apply. A special mandatory redemption at 100% of issue price triggers if Hennessy is not consummated by January 6, 2027, or the agreement terminates earlier. Watch Hennessy closing timing and the redemption trigger.
